title: Cyber Hackathon 2026
summary: A student-focused cyber defence challenge with tracks including AI for cyber defence, digital forensics, threat intelligence, secure infrastructure, and open-source intelligence.
description: The official guidelines state that registration and development run from 12 October through 26 October 2026. The listed team requirement is three to four students. Review official guidelines and selected problem statements.
notes: Verify current registration status and problem statement tracks before applying.

title: NHAI Winter Internship Programme 2026–27
summary: A one-month winter internship programme connected to ongoing National Highway projects, scheduled from December 2026 into January 2027.
description: The Press Information Bureau announced that applications are due by 20 October 2026 and that institute verification and recommendation are required. Open to undergraduate civil, engineering, and data disciplines.
notes: Institute recommendation is required. Check official portal for discipline-specific eligibility.

title: SAARTHI-26 Student Hackathon
summary: A student-run hackathon scheduled for 31 October to 2 November 2026, with tracks including AI, healthcare, and smart cities.
description: The official event site lists event dates and directs applicants to an online form. Teams of 2 to 4 participants work on designated problem statements.
notes: Registration deadline and final round format need confirmation on event website.

title: Google Summer of Code (GSoC) 2026
summary: An international online mentoring program introducing post-secondary students and beginners to open source software development with stipend support.
description: Students work with an open source mentor organization on a 12-week programming project. Applications open in spring, followed by community bonding and active coding phases.
notes: Participants must be at least 18 years old and eligible to work in their country of residence.

title: Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2026
organization: Ministry of Education Innovation Cell & AICTE
summary: India's nationwide student initiative providing students a platform to solve pressing problems of ministries, departments, industries, and NGOs.
description: Teams of six students (with mandatory female representation) compete in hardware and software editions. College internal rounds nominate finalist teams for national grand finales.
mode: Hybrid (Internal rounds online, Grand Finale on-site)
notes: College SPOC endorsement required for official team submission.

title: MLH Fellowship Open Source Cohort
summary: A 12-week remote internship alternative where software engineering students contribute to major open source projects under professional mentorship.
description: Fellows collaborate in small cohorts on real-world libraries used by millions, receive educational stipends, and attend technical masterclasses.
notes: Rolling admissions; early applications receive priority review.

title: LFX Mentorship Spring Term
summary: Structured remote mentorship opportunities for developers contributing to Linux Foundation projects like Kubernetes, Hyperledger, and Cloud Native.
description: Selected mentees work directly with experienced maintainers for 12 weeks, receiving stipends upon milestone completion and community recognition.
notes: Requires GitHub account profile and prerequisite task submissions.

title: Flipkart GRiD 7.0 Engineering Challenge
summary: Flagship engineering campus challenge featuring real-world e-commerce problem statements in software development, robotics, and generative AI.
description: Multi-tiered competition with online quiz qualifiers, prototype development, and grand finale presentations before senior engineering leadership. Top teams receive pre-placement interviews.
notes: Open to batch 2026, 2027, and 2028 engineering undergraduates.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2026
summary: Global student technology competition encouraging student founders and developers to build purpose-driven AI startups using Microsoft Azure.
description: Students submit technological prototypes leveraging AI and Azure cloud services. Category winners receive mentorship, global founder credits, and cash prizes.
notes: Working prototype and demonstration video required with submission.

title: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
summary: Merit-cum-means scholarship supporting up to 5,000 meritorious first-year undergraduate students in any stream of study across India.
description: Selected scholars receive financial grants up to INR 2 Lakhs over their degree duration, plus development workshops and mentorship alumni networks.
notes: Must be enrolled full-time in first year of regular undergraduate degree.

title: Tata Crucible Campus Quiz 2026
summary: India's largest business quiz for full-time college students, testing acumen in business, economics, technology, and emerging global markets.
description: Online cluster prelims followed by live regional finals and national championship, with cash prizes and national recognition.
notes: Both team members must be from the same college or university campus.

title: Amazon Future Engineer Scholarship 2026
summary: Financial support and mentorship initiative for female first-year students pursuing computer science or related engineering degrees.
description: Scholars receive financial assistance of INR 50,000 per year, a personal laptop, and curated Amazon mentorship alongside skill-building sessions.
notes: Open to women students enrolled in first-year engineering degree programs.

title: Adobe India Women-in-Technology Scholarship
summary: Scholarship program recognizing outstanding female students demonstrating excellence in computing and technology.
description: Recipients receive tuition reimbursement, opportunity to interview for Adobe India internships, and mentorship from senior research scientists.
notes: Resume, academic transcripts, and technical essay required.

title: Google Solution Challenge 2026
summary: Global student hackathon challenging university students to develop solutions for one or more of the United Nations 17 Sustainable Development Goals.
description: Participants use Google technologies like Flutter, Android, Firebase, and Google Cloud. Top 100 teams receive mentoring, with finalists winning cash prizes.
notes: At least one team member must be affiliated with an active GDG/GDSC campus chapter.

title: Outreachy Open Source Paid Internship
summary: Remote diversity internship program providing three months of mentored open source work with USD 7,000 stipend support.
description: Interns contribute to free and open source software (FOSS) projects in software development, data science, documentation, user experience, and testing.
notes: Requires completion of initial eligibility questionnaire and contribution period.

title: Goldman Sachs Engineering Campus Hiring
summary: Nationwide hiring initiative identifying talent across engineering colleges in India for summer analyst internships and full-time engineering roles.
description: Candidates undergo multi-stage aptitude, programming, and system design assessments, leading to interview rounds with technology divisions in Bengaluru and Hyderabad.
notes: Registration open to pre-final and final year undergraduate engineering students.

title: ICPC Asia Regional Programming Contest
summary: The premier global collegiate algorithmic programming championship for teams of three university students representing their institution.
description: Teams solve 10-13 complex algorithmic challenges under strict five-hour timing constraints. Top regional teams qualify for the ICPC World Finals.
notes: Each team must be registered with a recognized faculty coach.

title: GitHub Octernships Student Program
summary: Connects student developers with partner tech companies worldwide for paid, remote micro-internships solving production-grade issues.
description: Students work on real developer tasks, earn monthly stipends, and build verifiable public contributions on their GitHub portfolios.
notes: Requires verified GitHub Student Developer Pack membership.

title: J.P. Morgan Code for Good Hackathon
summary: 24-hour virtual hackathon where student teams develop technical solutions for leading non-profit organizations alongside expert technologists.
description: Students tackle social impact challenges. Participating students receive direct consideration for summer technology analyst internship programs.
notes: Online coding assessment required as first qualification round.

title: ISRO Student Internship & Project Training
summary: Technical internship and curriculum project work for undergraduate engineering and science students at premier space research facilities.
description: Students engage in research projects under space scientists in satellite systems, remote sensing, telemetry, and avionics.
notes: Principal/HOD recommendation and minimum 60% aggregate score required.

title: Kaggle University Machine Learning Challenge
summary: Global student benchmark competition challenging university teams to build state-of-the-art predictive and generative machine learning models.
description: Teams compete on curated benchmark datasets with public and private leaderboards. Top entries share cash awards and receive GPU compute credits.
notes: Submissions evaluated automatically against held-out validation test split.
